$description: Lazu canonical color tokens. Kumo Native / Warm Utility semantic light and dark themes.

rules.material: Warm neutral surfaces establish hierarchy through semantic roles and hairlines.
rules.action: Warm orange is reserved for the primary action, focus, current tab and minimal brand identification.
rules.navigation: Selected navigation uses a neutral fill; orange may accent its icon but not fill the row.
rules.semantic: Green, amber and red are reserved for success, warning and danger.
rules.accessibility: Color never carries state alone; pair it with text, shape or icon.
rules.dark: Dark mode is a warm-neutral semantic mapping, not the former Routing Ink plum-black system.
